Google confirms October 2026 core update rollout

Google confirmed on Friday that its October 2026 core update began rolling out at 11:00 a.m. Pacific time, according to a post on the Google Search Status Dashboard. The company said the rollout may take up to two weeks.

"This is a regular update designed to better surface relevant, satisfying content," Google's Search Liaison said in a post. Sites that see changes are advised to review the company's guidance on helpful content rather than make quick technical changes.

The last core update, in June 2026, took 16 days to complete. Rank-tracking tools including Semrush Sensor and Mozcast showed volatility scores of 7.8 and 92 degrees respectively on the first day of that rollout.
